from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsPayable(BaseModel):
    """Accounts payable data extracted from one company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the filing")
    accounts_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported accounts payable amount")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount: 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="How the accounts payable line is labeled in the filing")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial statement")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the accounts payable figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyAccountsPayable]
